meaning: to pass an examination or test

examples.pinyin: gōng rén zuì zhōng tōng guò le jià shǐ kǎo shì.

examples.pinyin: tā shùn lì tōng guò le qī mò kǎo shì.

examples.english: Her eyes were full of happiness.

examples.pinyin: yīng ér dàn shēng hòu, jiā lǐ chōng mǎn huān xiào.

examples.pinyin: tā de zhōng xīn hé gōng láo dé dào rèn kě.

examples.pinyin: Zhè cì chéng gōng yǒu dà jiā de gōng láo.
examples.english: Everyone deserves credit for this success.

examples.pinyin: lǎo hǔ tū rán gōng jī le fù jìn de yě shòu.

examples.pinyin: Gù shi zhōng de láng tū rán gōng jī le yáng qún.

examples.chinese: 咖喱里放了莴苣，颜色十分丰富。
examples.pinyin: gā lí lǐ fàng le wō jù, yán sè shí fēn fēng fù.
examples.english: Lettuce was added to the curry, giving it a colorful appearance.

examples.pinyin: Huā yuán lǐ de sè cǎi fēi cháng fēng fù.
examples.english: The garden has a rich variety of colors.

examples.chinese: 大家为共同的梦想贡献力量。
examples.pinyin: dà jiā wèi gòng tóng de mèng xiǎng gòng xiàn lì liang.

examples.chinese: 他严肃地提醒大家检查建筑安全。
examples.pinyin: tā yán sù de tí xǐng dà jiā jiǎn chá jiàn zhù ān quán.

examples.pinyin: Tā de mù guāng tíng liú zài nà zhāng jiù zhào piàn shàng.

examples.english: The two sides sue over a commission dispute.

examples.english: After his friends teased him, he laughed and argued back.

meaning: to see; to catch sight of

examples.chinese: 女儿旅行时，看见一只蟾蜍。
examples.pinyin: nǚ ér lǚ xíng shí, kàn jiàn yī zhī chán chú.
examples.english: My daughter saw a toad while traveling.

examples.chinese: 他在故宫看见精美铜器。
examples.pinyin: tā zài gù gōng kàn jiàn jīng měi tóng qì.
examples.english: He sees beautiful bronze objects in the Forbidden City.

examples.chinese: 手表坏了，我不知道现在几点。
examples.pinyin: shǒu biǎo huài le, wǒ bù zhī dào xiàn zài jǐ diǎn.
examples.english: My watch is broken, so I do not know what time it is.

examples.chinese: 车票丢了，现在咋办？
examples.pinyin: chē piào diū le, xiàn zài zǎ bàn?
examples.english: I've lost my ticket. What should I do now?

examples.chinese: 他跌倒了，膝盖擦出了伤口。
examples.pinyin: tā diē dǎo le, xī gài cā chū le shāng kǒu.
examples.english: He fell and scraped his knee.

examples.chinese: 弟弟在台阶上跌倒了。
examples.pinyin: dì di zài tái jiē shàng diē dǎo le.
examples.english: My younger brother falls on the steps.

meaning: to end; to finish; to conclude

examples.chinese: 祷告结束后，他戴上手套出门。
examples.pinyin: dǎo gào jié shù hòu, tā dài shang shǒu tào chū mén.
examples.english: After the prayer, he put on his gloves and went out.

examples.chinese: 各政党协商，努力结束社会动荡。
examples.pinyin: gè zhèng dǎng xié shāng, nǔ lì jié shù shè huì dòng dàng.
examples.english: The parties negotiate to end social unrest.

examples.chinese: 抉择时要谨慎，也不能因噎废食。
examples.pinyin: jué zé shí yào jǐn shèn, yě bù néng yīn yē fèi shí.
examples.english: Choose carefully without giving up because of a small risk.

examples.chinese: 面对两份工作，她难以抉择。
examples.pinyin: miàn duì liǎng fèn gōng zuò, tā nán yǐ jué zé.
examples.english: Faced with two job offers, she finds it hard to choose.

examples.chinese: 缺少某种物质可能导致身体不适。
examples.pinyin: quē shǎo mǒu zhǒng wù zhì kě néng dǎo zhì shēn tǐ bù shì.
examples.english: A deficiency of a substance may cause physical discomfort.

examples.chinese: 这道菜还缺少一点盐。
examples.pinyin: zhè dào cài hái quē shǎo yī diǎn yán.
examples.english: This dish still needs a little salt.

examples.chinese: 联盟决定明天举行新的会议。
examples.pinyin: lián méng jué dìng míng tiān jǔ xíng xīn de huì yì.
examples.english: The alliance decided to hold another meeting tomorrow.

examples.chinese: 我们决定周末去参观博物馆。
examples.pinyin: wǒ men jué dìng zhōu mò qù cān guān bó wù guǎn.
examples.english: We decided to visit the museum at the weekend.

examples.chinese: 妈妈一直唠叨，他便掏出手机打电话。
examples.pinyin: mā ma yī zhí láo dao, tā biàn tāo chū shǒu jī dǎ diàn huà.
examples.english: Mom kept nagging, so he took out his phone to make a call.

examples.chinese: 他总是唠叨同一件事。
examples.pinyin: tā zǒng shì láo dao tóng yī jiàn shì.
examples.english: He keeps talking repetitively about the same thing.

examples.chinese: 计划遭遇阻挠，大家仍继续努力。
examples.pinyin: jì huà zāo yù zǔ náo, dà jiā réng jì xù nǔ lì.
examples.english: The plan meets resistance, but everyone keeps trying.

examples.chinese: 他遭遇厄运后总是绷脸不笑。
examples.pinyin: tā zāo yù è yùn hòu zǒng shì běng liǎn bù xiào.
examples.english: After his misfortune, he keeps a stern face.

examples.chinese: 他不断炫耀自己的豪华汽车。
examples.pinyin: tā bù duàn xuàn yào zì jǐ de háo huá qì chē.
examples.english: He keeps showing off his luxury car.

examples.chinese: 他们住进一家豪华酒店。
examples.pinyin: tā men zhù jìn yī jiā háo huá jiǔ diàn.
examples.english: They check into a luxury hotel.

examples.chinese: 他丝毫没有放弃的念头。
examples.pinyin: tā sī háo méi yǒu fàng qì de niàn tou.
examples.english: He has no intention of giving up at all.

examples.chinese: 她丝毫没有退缩。
examples.pinyin: tā sī háo méi yǒu tuì suō.
examples.english: She does not back down in the slightest.

examples.chinese: 倒下的大树阻挡了去墓地的路。
examples.pinyin: dǎo xià de dà shù zǔ dǎng le qù mù dì de lù.
examples.english: The fallen tree blocked the road to the cemetery.

examples.chinese: 老树在暴风中倒下。
examples.pinyin: lǎo shù zài bào fēng zhōng dǎo xià.
examples.english: The old tree falls in the storm.

examples.chinese: 善良的邻居经常帮助老人。
examples.pinyin: shàn liáng de lín jū jīng cháng bāng zhù lǎo rén.
examples.english: The kind neighbor often helps older people.

examples.chinese: 老人的双眼炯炯有神。
examples.pinyin: lǎo rén de shuāng yǎn jiǒng jiǒng yǒu shén.
examples.english: The old man's eyes are bright and lively.

examples.chinese: 孩子们坐在草地上休息。
examples.pinyin: hái zi men zuò zài cǎo dì shàng xiū xi.
examples.english: The children sit on the grass to rest.

examples.chinese: 孩子在草地上放风筝。
examples.pinyin: hái zi zài cǎo dì shàng fàng fēng zheng.
examples.english: The child flies a kite on the grass.

examples.chinese: 大家打扫完教室便休息了。
examples.pinyin: dà jiā dǎ sǎo wán jiào shì biàn xiū xi le.
examples.english: Everyone rested after cleaning the classroom.

examples.chinese: 他把邋遢的房间打扫干净。
examples.pinyin: tā bǎ lā ta de fáng jiān dǎ sǎo gān jìng.
examples.english: He cleans up the untidy room.

examples.chinese: 好客的主人拥抱客人，欢迎他们进屋。
examples.pinyin: hào kè de zhǔ rén yōng bào kè rén, huān yíng tā men jìn wū.
examples.english: The hospitable host hugged the guests and welcomed them inside.

examples.chinese: 久别重逢的朋友互相拥抱。
examples.pinyin: jiǔ bié chóng féng de péng you hù xiāng yōng bào.
examples.english: The friends embrace after a long separation.

examples.chinese: 货物准时到达，经理祝贺团队。
examples.pinyin: huò wù zhǔn shí dào dá, jīng lǐ zhù hè tuán duì.
examples.english: The goods arrived on time, and the manager congratulated the team.

examples.chinese: 火车将在十点到达。
examples.pinyin: huǒ chē jiāng zài shí diǎn dào dá.
examples.english: The train will arrive at ten.

examples.chinese: 嘲笑别人的外貌会冒犯对方。
examples.pinyin: cháo xiào bié ren de wài mào huì mào fàn duì fāng.
examples.english: Mocking someone's appearance can offend them.

examples.chinese: 请不要嘲笑别人的口音。
examples.pinyin: qǐng bù yào cháo xiào bié rén de kǒu yīn.
examples.english: Please do not mock other people's accents.

examples.chinese: 敲门以后，请等主人回应再进去。
examples.pinyin: qiāo mén yǐ hòu, qǐng děng zhǔ rén huí yìng zài jìn qù.
examples.english: After knocking, wait for the host to respond before entering.

examples.chinese: 有人咚咚地敲门。
examples.pinyin: yǒu rén dōng dōng de qiāo mén.
examples.english: Someone pounds on the door.

examples.chinese: 他没有抛弃原来的计划。
examples.pinyin: tā méi yǒu pāo qì yuán lái de jì huà.
examples.english: He has not abandoned his original plan.

examples.chinese: 他不愿抛弃自己的梦想。
examples.pinyin: tā bù yuàn pāo qì zì jǐ de mèng xiǎng.
examples.english: He is unwilling to abandon his dream.

examples.chinese: 他巧妙地改进了旧方法。
examples.pinyin: tā qiǎo miào de gǎi jìn le jiù fāng fǎ.
examples.english: He cleverly improved the old method.

examples.chinese: 这个设计很巧妙。
examples.pinyin: zhè ge shè jì hěn qiǎo miào.
examples.english: This design is ingenious.

examples.chinese: 口罩稍微有点大，他调整了带子。
examples.pinyin: kǒu zhào shāo wēi yǒu diǎn dà, tā tiáo zhěng le dài zi.
examples.english: The mask was slightly too large, so he adjusted the straps.

examples.chinese: 整体效果不错，可惜颜色稍微太暗。
examples.pinyin: zhěng tǐ xiào guǒ bù cuò, kě xī yán sè shāo wēi tài àn.
examples.english: The overall result is good, but unfortunately the colors are a little too dark.

examples.chinese: 这个办法有效果，情况正在改善。
examples.pinyin: zhè ge bàn fǎ yǒu xiào guǒ, qíng kuàng zhèng zài gǎi shàn.
examples.english: This method is working, and the situation is improving.

examples.chinese: 整体效果不错，可惜颜色稍微太暗。
examples.pinyin: zhěng tǐ xiào guǒ bù cuò, kě xī yán sè shāo wēi tài àn.
examples.english: The overall result is good, but unfortunately the colors are a little too dark.

examples.chinese: 灯泡爆炸以后，房间陷入黑暗。
examples.pinyin: dēng pào bào zhà yǐ hòu, fáng jiān xiàn rù hēi àn.
examples.english: After the light bulb exploded, the room became dark.

examples.chinese: 远处的油罐突然爆炸。
examples.pinyin: yuǎn chù de yóu guàn tū rán bào zhà.
examples.english: The distant oil tank suddenly explodes.

examples.chinese: 樵夫发现路消失在茂密的森林里。
examples.pinyin: qiáo fū fā xiàn lù xiāo shī zài mào mì de sēn lín lǐ.
examples.english: The woodcutter noticed the path disappearing into the dense forest.

examples.chinese: 船影慢慢消失在雾里。
examples.pinyin: chuán yǐng màn màn xiāo shī zài wù lǐ.
examples.english: The boat's outline slowly disappears into the mist.

examples.chinese: 侄子彬彬有礼地向客人打招呼。
examples.pinyin: zhí zi bīn bīn yǒu lǐ de xiàng kè rén dǎ zhāo hu.
examples.english: My nephew greeted the guests politely.

examples.chinese: 他微笑着向邻居打招呼。
examples.pinyin: tā wēi xiào zhe xiàng lín jū dǎ zhāo hu.
examples.english: He greets the neighbor with a smile.

examples.chinese: 严格的教练要求大家按时集合。
examples.pinyin: yán gé de jiào liàn yāo qiú dà jiā àn shí jí hé.
examples.english: The strict coach required everyone to gather on time.

examples.chinese: 老师要求我们认真听讲。
examples.pinyin: lǎo shī yāo qiú wǒ men rèn zhēn tīng jiǎng.
examples.english: The teacher requires us to listen carefully.

examples.chinese: 柱子上挂着几根漂亮的羽毛。
examples.pinyin: zhù zi shàng guà zhe jǐ gēn piào liang de yǔ máo.
examples.english: Several lovely feathers hang from the pillar.

examples.chinese: 哇，这朵花真漂亮！
examples.pinyin: wā, zhè duǒ huā zhēn piào liang!
examples.english: Wow, this flower is beautiful!

examples.chinese: 这里还剩多少水果？
examples.pinyin: zhè lǐ hái shèng duō shao shuǐ guǒ?
examples.english: How much fruit is left here?

examples.chinese: 这件外套多少钱？
examples.pinyin: zhè jiàn wài tào duō shao qián?
examples.english: How much does this coat cost?

meaning: be noisy or make a racket

examples.chinese: 孩子不再吵闹，妈妈露出了微笑。
examples.pinyin: hái zi bù zài chǎo nào, mā ma lù chū le wēi xiào.
examples.english: The child stopped making noise, and Mom smiled.

examples.chinese: 孩子们在院里吵闹。
examples.pinyin: hái zi men zài yuàn lǐ chǎo nào.
examples.english: The children make a racket in the courtyard.

examples.chinese: 他赢得比赛，向大家露出微笑。
examples.pinyin: tā yíng dé bǐ sài, xiàng dà jiā lù chū wēi xiào.
examples.english: He won the competition and smiled at everyone.

examples.chinese: 她看着照片，轻轻微笑。
examples.pinyin: tā kàn zhe zhào piàn, qīng qīng wēi xiào.
examples.english: She looked at the photo and smiled softly.

examples.chinese: 画中释迦以手势召唤弟子。
examples.pinyin: huà zhōng shì jiā yǐ shǒu shì zhào huàn dì zǐ.
examples.english: The painting shows Shakyamuni beckoning his disciples.

examples.chinese: 母亲在门口召唤孩子回家。
examples.pinyin: mǔ qīn zài mén kǒu zhào huàn hái zi huí jiā.
examples.english: The mother calls the child home from the doorway.

examples.chinese: 腐烂的大蒜不能用来调味。
examples.pinyin: fǔ làn de dà suàn bù néng yòng lái tiáo wèi.
examples.english: Rotten garlic cannot be used for seasoning.

examples.chinese: 厨师用盐和姜调味。
examples.pinyin: chú shī yòng yán hé jiāng tiáo wèi.
examples.english: The chef seasons the food with salt and ginger.

examples.chinese: 大阪的朋友邀请我们去看樱花。
examples.pinyin: dà bǎn de péng you yāo qǐng wǒ men qù kàn yīng huā.
examples.english: Our friends in Osaka invited us to see the cherry blossoms.

examples.chinese: 宴会邀请各地俊彦与豪杰。
examples.pinyin: yàn huì yāo qǐng gè dì jùn yàn yǔ háo jié.
examples.english: The banquet invites talented and outstanding people.

examples.chinese: 他侥幸赶上最后一天缴费。
examples.pinyin: tā jiǎo xìng gǎn shàng zuì hòu yī tiān jiǎo fèi.
examples.english: He just manages to pay on the final day.

examples.chinese: 他侥幸躲过了这场风暴。
examples.pinyin: tā jiǎo xìng duǒ guò le zhè chǎng fēng bào.
examples.english: He escapes the storm by good luck.

meaning: fish with a rod and line

examples.chinese: 他周末常到河边钓鱼。
examples.pinyin: tā zhōu mò cháng dào hé biān diào yú.
examples.english: He often fishes by the river on weekends.

examples.chinese: 爷爷喜欢在湖边钓鱼。
examples.pinyin: yé ye xǐ huan zài hú biān diào yú.
examples.english: Grandfather likes fishing by the lake.

examples.chinese: 他平静地叙述经过，没有激动的情绪。
examples.pinyin: tā píng jìng de xù shù jīng guò, méi yǒu jī dòng de qíng xù.
examples.english: He calmly described what happened without becoming emotional.

examples.chinese: 听到好消息，他十分激动。
examples.pinyin: tīng dào hǎo xiāo xi, tā shí fēn jī dòng.
examples.english: He is very excited on hearing the good news.

examples.chinese: 春天，他们开始驯养小马。
examples.pinyin: chūn tiān, tā men kāi shǐ xùn yǎng xiǎo mǎ.
examples.english: In spring, they began training the foal.

examples.chinese: 剥削劳动者会剥夺他们的尊严。
examples.pinyin: bō xuē láo dòng zhě huì bō duó tā men de zūn yán.
examples.english: Exploiting workers robs them of their dignity.

meaning: they or them, for things or animals

examples.chinese: 这些鱼很灵活，很难抓住它们。
examples.pinyin: zhè xiē yú hěn líng huó, hěn nán zhuā zhù tā men.
examples.english: These fish are agile and hard to catch.

examples.chinese: 这些小鸟很可爱，我喜欢它们。
examples.pinyin: zhè xiē xiǎo niǎo hěn kě ài, wǒ xǐ huan tā men.
examples.english: These little birds are lovely; I like them.

examples.chinese: 天鹅在水草之间缓缓穿梭。
examples.pinyin: tiān é zài shuǐ cǎo zhī jiān huǎn huǎn chuān suō.
examples.english: The swan moves gently among the aquatic plants.

examples.chinese: 小鱼在水草间穿梭。
examples.pinyin: xiǎo yú zài shuǐ cǎo jiān chuān suō.
examples.english: Little fish dart back and forth among the aquatic plants.

examples.chinese: 请把事情发生的过程讲清楚。
examples.pinyin: qǐng bǎ shì qing fā shēng de guò chéng jiǎng qīng chu.
examples.english: Please explain clearly how things happened.

examples.chinese: 老师解释了酯化反应的过程。
examples.pinyin: lǎo shī jiě shì le zhǐ huà fǎn yìng de guò chéng.
examples.english: The teacher explained the process of esterification.

examples.chinese: 她有绘画天赋，却付不起课程费用。
examples.pinyin: tā yǒu huì huà tiān fù, què fù bù qǐ kè chéng fèi yòng.
examples.english: She has a talent for painting but cannot afford the lessons.

examples.chinese: 他订阅了一个练习英语听力的课程。
examples.pinyin: tā dìng yuè le yī ge liàn xí yīng yǔ tīng lì de kè chéng.
examples.english: He subscribed to a course for practicing English listening skills.

examples.chinese: 哦，原来你在这里。
examples.pinyin: ò, yuán lái nǐ zài zhè lǐ.
examples.english: Oh, so you are here.

examples.chinese: 哦，我明白你的意思了。
examples.pinyin: ò, wǒ míng bai nǐ de yì si le.
examples.english: Oh, I understand what you mean now.

examples.chinese: 苛刻的考官故意刁难考生。
examples.pinyin: kē kè de kǎo guān gù yì diāo nàn kǎo shēng.
examples.english: The strict examiner deliberately makes things difficult.

examples.chinese: 这项要求太苛刻了。
examples.pinyin: zhè xiàng yāo qiú tài kē kè le.
examples.english: This requirement is too demanding.

examples.chinese: 磨刀时有摩擦声，旁边石磨也在转。
examples.pinyin: mó dāo shí yǒu mó cā shēng, páng biān shí mò yě zài zhuǎn.
examples.english: Scraping sounds accompany knife sharpening beside a turning millstone.

examples.chinese: 木头摩擦时发出声音。
examples.pinyin: mù tou mó cā shí fā chū shēng yīn.
examples.english: The wood makes a sound as it rubs.

examples.chinese: 左右看看，确认没有车再过马路。
examples.pinyin: zuǒ yòu kàn kan, què rèn méi yǒu chē zài guò mǎ lù.
examples.english: Look both ways and make sure there are no cars before crossing.

examples.chinese: 过路口前，要向左右看。
examples.pinyin: guò lù kǒu qián, yào xiàng zuǒ yòu kàn.
examples.english: Look left and right before crossing the intersection.

examples.chinese: 火焰很快吞噬了这间小屋。
examples.pinyin: huǒ yàn hěn kuài tūn shì le zhè jiān xiǎo wū.
examples.english: The flames quickly engulfed the cottage.

examples.chinese: 焱字可以表示火焰。
examples.pinyin: yàn zì kě yǐ biǎo shì huǒ yàn.
examples.english: Yan can mean a flame.

examples.chinese: 货物准时到达，经理祝贺团队。
examples.pinyin: huò wù zhǔn shí dào dá, jīng lǐ zhù hè tuán duì.
examples.english: The goods arrived on time, and the manager congratulated the team.

examples.chinese: 朋友们祝贺她顺利毕业。
examples.pinyin: péng you men zhù hè tā shùn lì bì yè.
examples.english: Her friends congratulate her on graduating successfully.

examples.chinese: 他们不愿互相束缚，决定分道扬镳。
examples.pinyin: tā men bù yuàn hù xiāng shù fù, jué dìng fēn dào yáng biāo.
examples.english: They choose separate paths rather than hold each other back.

examples.chinese: 旧观念束缚了他的想法。
examples.pinyin: jiù guān niàn shù fù le tā de xiǎng fǎ.
examples.english: Old ideas restrict his thinking.

examples.chinese: 她买了一些新鲜的茶叶。
examples.pinyin: tā mǎi le yī xiē xīn xiān de chá yè.
examples.english: She bought some fresh tea leaves.

examples.chinese: 篮子里还有一些鸡蛋。
examples.pinyin: lán zi lǐ hái yǒu yī xiē jī dàn.
examples.english: There are still some eggs in the basket.

examples.chinese: 这次报酬增加了他的收入。
examples.pinyin: zhè cì bào chou zēng jiā le tā de shōu rù.
examples.english: The payment for this work increased his income.

examples.chinese: 这份工作增加了他的收入。
examples.pinyin: zhè fèn gōng zuò zēng jiā le tā de shōu rù.
examples.english: This job increases his income.

examples.chinese: 哎呀，她竟诧异地发现钱不见了。
examples.pinyin: āi yā, tā jìng chà yì de fā xiàn qián bù jiàn le.
examples.english: Oh dear, she is surprised to find the money missing.

examples.chinese: 哎呀，杯子掉到地上了！
examples.pinyin: āi yā, bēi zi diào dào dì shàng le!
examples.english: Oh, the cup has fallen on the floor!

examples.chinese: 请别打扰她，她正在认真写字。
examples.pinyin: qǐng bié dǎ rǎo tā, tā zhèng zài rèn zhēn xiě zì.
examples.english: Please do not disturb her; she is concentrating on writing.

examples.chinese: 古文用搦管表示提笔写字。
examples.pinyin: gǔ wén yòng nuò guǎn biǎo shì tí bǐ xiě zì.
examples.english: Classical writing uses this expression to mean taking up a brush to write.

examples.chinese: 假如明天放假，我们就去海边。
examples.pinyin: jiǎ rú míng tiān fàng jià, wǒ men jiù qù hǎi biān.
examples.english: If tomorrow is a holiday, we will go to the seaside.

examples.chinese: 假如有时间，我会来帮忙。
examples.pinyin: jiǎ rú yǒu shí jiān, wǒ huì lái bāng máng.
examples.english: If I have time, I will come and help.

examples.chinese: 她优雅地跳舞，却扭伤了脚踝。
examples.pinyin: tā yōu yǎ de tiào wǔ, què niǔ shāng le jiǎo huái.
examples.english: She danced gracefully but twisted her ankle.

examples.chinese: 她的动作轻盈优雅。
examples.pinyin: tā de dòng zuò qīng yíng yōu yǎ.
examples.english: Her movements are light and graceful.

examples.chinese: 夏天，大厦下面常有人乘凉。
examples.pinyin: xià tiān, dà shà xià miàn cháng yǒu rén chéng liáng.
examples.english: In summer, people often cool off beneath the tall building.

examples.chinese: 元素表上，锶排在钙的下面。
examples.pinyin: yuán sù biǎo shàng, sī pái zài gài de xià miàn.
examples.english: Strontium appears below calcium in the periodic table.

examples.chinese: 也许天气会变，我们先把握这次机会。
examples.pinyin: yě xǔ tiān qì huì biàn, wǒ men xiān bǎ wò zhè cì jī huì.
examples.english: The weather may change, so let's make the most of this opportunity now.

examples.chinese: 也许他已经到家了。
examples.pinyin: yě xǔ tā yǐ jīng dào jiā le.
examples.english: Perhaps he is already home.

examples.chinese: 诈骗真相公布后，听众一片哗然。
examples.pinyin: zhà piàn zhēn xiàng gōng bù hòu, tīng zhòng yī piàn huá rán.
examples.english: The audience reacts noisily when the fraud is exposed.

examples.chinese: 警方提醒市民警惕诈骗。
examples.pinyin: jǐng fāng tí xǐng shì mín jǐng tì zhà piàn.
examples.english: The police remind citizens to watch out for scams.

examples.chinese: 学校反对排斥，欢迎广大学生。
examples.pinyin: xué xiào fǎn duì pái chì, huān yíng guǎng dà xué sheng.
examples.english: The school opposes exclusion and welcomes all students.

examples.chinese: 大家不应排斥新来的同学。
examples.pinyin: dà jiā bù yīng pái chì xīn lái de tóng xué.
examples.english: Nobody should exclude the new classmate.

examples.chinese: 他听到价格以后，惊讶地睁大眼睛。
examples.pinyin: tā tīng dào jià gé yǐ hòu, jīng yà de zhēng dà yǎn jing.
examples.english: He opened his eyes wide in surprise after hearing the price.

examples.chinese: 听说他要离开，我很惊讶。
examples.pinyin: tīng shuō tā yào lí kāi, wǒ hěn jīng yà.
examples.english: I am surprised to hear that he is leaving.

examples.chinese: 别吓唬孩子，他刚才已经受了惊吓。
examples.pinyin: bié xià hu hái zi, tā gāng cái yǐ jīng shòu le jīng xià.
examples.english: Do not frighten the child; he has already had a scare.

examples.chinese: 突然的雷声让她受了惊吓。
examples.pinyin: tū rán de léi shēng ràng tā shòu le jīng xià.
examples.english: The sudden thunder gives her a fright.

examples.chinese: 海湾的颜色随着光线变化。
examples.pinyin: hǎi wān de yán sè suí zhe guāng xiàn biàn huà.
examples.english: The bay's colors change with the light.

examples.chinese: 湖水的颜色随着天气变化。
examples.pinyin: hú shuǐ de yán sè suí zhe tiān qì biàn huà.
examples.english: The color of the lake water varies with the weather.

examples.chinese: 火箭按计划发射成功。
examples.pinyin: huǒ jiàn àn jì huà fā shè chéng gōng.
examples.english: The rocket launches successfully as planned.

examples.chinese: 这枚卫星明天将发射升空。
examples.pinyin: zhè méi wèi xīng míng tiān jiāng fā shè shēng kōng.
examples.english: This satellite will be launched tomorrow.

examples.chinese: 这家店卖高档衣服，当然也有普通款式。
examples.pinyin: zhè jiā diàn mài gāo dàng yī fu, dāng rán yě yǒu pǔ tōng kuǎn shì.
examples.english: This shop sells high-end clothing, and of course it also has ordinary styles.

examples.chinese: 你当然可以借这本书。
examples.pinyin: nǐ dāng rán kě yǐ jiè zhè běn shū.
examples.english: Of course you may borrow this book.

examples.chinese: 护士解释检查前膀胱应适当充盈。
examples.pinyin: hù shi jiě shì jiǎn chá qián páng guāng yīng shì dàng chōng yíng.
examples.english: The nurse explains that the bladder should be suitably full before the scan.

examples.chinese: 他选择了适当的时机发言。
examples.pinyin: tā xuǎn zé le shì dàng de shí jī fā yán.
examples.english: He chooses an appropriate moment to speak.

examples.chinese: 这家餐厅的老板收藏钻石。
examples.pinyin: zhè jiā cān tīng de lǎo bǎn shōu cáng zuàn shí.
examples.english: The owner of this restaurant collects diamonds.

examples.chinese: 爷爷喜欢收藏旧邮票。
examples.pinyin: yé ye xǐ huān shōu cáng jiù yóu piào.
examples.english: Grandpa likes collecting old stamps.

examples.chinese: 丧事结束后，他仍为丧失亲人而悲伤。
examples.pinyin: sāng shì jié shù hòu, tā réng wèi sàng shī qīn rén ér bēi shāng.
examples.english: After the funeral, he was still grieving the loss of a loved one.

examples.chinese: 事故使他丧失了听力。
examples.pinyin: shì gù shǐ tā sàng shī le tīng lì.
examples.english: The accident caused him to lose his hearing.

examples.chinese: 轮船正在宽阔的海面上航行。
examples.pinyin: lún chuán zhèng zài kuān kuò de hǎi miàn shàng háng xíng.
examples.english: The ship sails across the open sea.

examples.chinese: 这艘船已经航行了三天。
examples.pinyin: zhè sōu chuán yǐ jīng háng xíng le sān tiān.
examples.english: This ship has been sailing for three days.

examples.chinese: 我们步行去看刚刚装潢好的房子。
examples.pinyin: wǒ men bù xíng qù kàn gāng gang zhuāng huáng hǎo de fáng zi.
examples.english: We walked over to see the newly decorated house.

examples.chinese: 你可以乘车，或者步行去公园。
examples.pinyin: nǐ kě yǐ chéng chē, huò zhě bù xíng qù gōng yuán.
examples.english: You can go to the park by vehicle or on foot.

examples.chinese: 展览介绍中华文明的辉煌成就。
examples.pinyin: zhǎn lǎn jiè shào zhōng huá wén míng de huī huáng chéng jiù.
examples.english: The exhibition presents Chinese civilization's great achievements.

examples.chinese: 这座剧院曾有辉煌的历史。
examples.pinyin: zhè zuò jù yuàn céng yǒu huī huáng de lì shǐ.
examples.english: This theater once had a glorious history.

examples.chinese: 清理肮脏环境，也须去除思想糟粕。
examples.pinyin: qīng lǐ āng zāng huán jìng, yě xū qù chú sī xiǎng zāo pò.
examples.english: Cleaning the surroundings also calls for discarding harmful ideas.

examples.chinese: 不要把肮脏的鞋子放在桌上。
examples.pinyin: bù yào bǎ āng zāng de xié zi fàng zài zhuō shàng.
examples.english: Do not put dirty shoes on the table.

examples.chinese: 慷慨的邻居给大家送来面包。
examples.pinyin: kāng kǎi de lín jū gěi dà jiā sòng lái miàn bāo.
examples.english: The generous neighbor brought everyone bread.

examples.chinese: 她慷慨地捐出了自己的奖金。
examples.pinyin: tā kāng kǎi de juān chū le zì jǐ de jiǎng jīn.
examples.english: She generously donated her prize money.

examples.chinese: 倒下的大树阻挡了去墓地的路。
examples.pinyin: dǎo xià de dà shù zǔ dǎng le qù mù dì de lù.
examples.english: The fallen tree blocked the road to the cemetery.

examples.chinese: 围栏阻挡了游客的去路。
examples.pinyin: wéi lán zǔ dǎng le yóu kè de qù lù.
examples.english: The fence blocked the tourists' path.

examples.chinese: 家人准备埋葬老人，并举行纪念仪式。
examples.pinyin: jiā rén zhǔn bèi mái zàng lǎo rén, bìng jǔ xíng jì niàn yí shì.
examples.english: The family prepared to bury the elderly person and hold a memorial ceremony.

examples.chinese: 他们把小鸟埋葬在树下。
examples.pinyin: tā men bǎ xiǎo niǎo mái zàng zài shù xià.
examples.english: They buried the little bird under the tree.

meaning: to ask someone a favor; please

examples.chinese: 拜托你帮忙联络明天来的客人。
examples.pinyin: bài tuō nǐ bāng máng lián luò míng tiān lái de kè rén.
examples.english: Please help contact the guests who are coming tomorrow.

examples.chinese: 我拜托邻居照看小猫。
examples.pinyin: wǒ bài tuō lín jū zhào kàn xiǎo māo.
examples.english: I asked my neighbor to look after the kitten.

examples.chinese: 各自准备好后，大家抢先回答。
examples.pinyin: gè zì zhǔn bèi hǎo hòu, dà jiā qiǎng xiān huí dá.
examples.english: Once ready, everyone tries to answer first.

examples.chinese: 兄弟分爨以后，各自做饭生活。
examples.pinyin: xiōng dì fēn cuàn yǐ hòu, gè zì zuò fàn shēng huó.
examples.english: After the brothers set up separate households, each cooked for himself.

examples.chinese: 鸟儿张开翅膀，在蓝天中飞翔。
examples.pinyin: niǎo r zhāng kāi chì bǎng, zài lán tiān zhōng fēi xiáng.
examples.english: The bird spreads its wings and flies through the blue sky.

examples.chinese: 雄鹰在山谷上空飞翔。
examples.pinyin: xióng yīng zài shān gǔ shàng kōng fēi xiáng.
examples.english: An eagle soars above the valley.

examples.chinese: 他们希望友谊能够长久。
examples.pinyin: tā men xī wàng yǒu yì néng gòu cháng jiǔ.
examples.english: They hope their friendship will last.

examples.chinese: 这段友谊维持了很长久的时间。
examples.pinyin: zhè duàn yǒu yì wéi chí le hěn cháng jiǔ de shí jiān.
examples.english: This friendship lasted for a very long time.

examples.chinese: 孩子长大后，离开家乡求学。
examples.pinyin: hái zi zhǎng dà hòu, lí kāi jiā xiāng qiú xué.
examples.english: After growing up, the child leaves home to study.

examples.chinese: 她长大以后想当老师。
examples.pinyin: tā zhǎng dà yǐ hòu xiǎng dāng lǎo shī.
examples.english: She wants to be a teacher when she grows up.

examples.chinese: 她用双手创造了美丽的作品。
examples.pinyin: tā yòng shuāng shǒu chuàng zào le měi lì de zuò pǐn.
examples.english: She created beautiful works with her hands.

examples.chinese: 孩子们一起创造了一个新故事。
examples.pinyin: hái zi men yī qǐ chuàng zào le yī gè xīn gù shi.
examples.english: The children created a new story together.

examples.chinese: 完善的制度保障了学生的安全。
examples.pinyin: wán shàn de zhì dù bǎo zhàng le xué sheng de ān quán.
examples.english: A well-developed system protects the students' safety.

examples.chinese: 这些措施能保障工人的安全。
examples.pinyin: zhè xiē cuò shī néng bǎo zhàng gōng rén de ān quán.
examples.english: These measures can safeguard the workers' safety.

examples.chinese: 尝试新方法前，他先记录平常的情况。
examples.pinyin: cháng shì xīn fāng fǎ qián, tā xiān jì lù píng cháng de qíng kuàng.
examples.english: Before trying the new method, he recorded what normally happened.

examples.chinese: 今天的街道比平常安静。
examples.pinyin: jīn tiān de jiē dào bǐ píng cháng ān jìng.
examples.english: The streets are quieter than usual today.

examples.chinese: 老师倡导助人为乐的高尚品德。
examples.pinyin: lǎo shī chàng dǎo zhù rén wéi lè de gāo shàng pǐn dé.
examples.english: The teacher promotes the virtue of helping others.

examples.chinese: 他因品德高尚而受到尊敬。
examples.pinyin: tā yīn pǐn dé gāo shàng ér shòu dào zūn jìng.
examples.english: He is respected for his noble character.

examples.chinese: 他挥手驱赶苍蝇，没有伤害小鸟。
examples.pinyin: tā huī shǒu qū gǎn cāng ying, méi yǒu shāng hài xiǎo niǎo.
examples.english: He waved away the flies without hurting the birds.

examples.chinese: 恶毒的诬陷伤害无辜者，十分可恶。
examples.pinyin: è dú de wū xiàn shāng hài wú gū zhě, shí fēn kě wù.
examples.english: Malicious false accusations harm innocent people and are hateful.

examples.chinese: 阳光照耀着花园，景色十分美妙。
examples.pinyin: yáng guāng zhào yào zhe huā yuán, jǐng sè shí fēn měi miào.
examples.english: Sunlight shines on the garden, creating a wonderful view.

examples.chinese: 阳光下的冰雪慢慢融化。
examples.pinyin: yáng guāng xià de bīng xuě màn màn róng huà.
examples.english: The ice and snow slowly melt in the sunshine.

examples.chinese: 走错方向，会妨碍大家准时到达。
examples.pinyin: zǒu cuò fāng xiàng, huì fáng ài dà jiā zhǔn shí dào dá.
examples.english: Going the wrong way will prevent everyone from arriving on time.

examples.chinese: 矢量既有大小，也有方向。
examples.pinyin: shǐ liàng jì yǒu dà xiǎo, yě yǒu fāng xiàng.
examples.english: A vector has both magnitude and direction.

examples.chinese: 加固堤坊有助于防止洪水漫入。
examples.pinyin: jiā gù dī fáng yǒu zhù yú fáng zhǐ hóng shuǐ màn rù.
examples.english: Strengthening the embankment helps keep floodwater out.

examples.chinese: 工人给铁板镀锌，防止生锈。
examples.pinyin: gōng rén gěi tiě bǎn dù xīn, fáng zhǐ shēng xiù.
examples.english: The workers coated the iron sheet with zinc to prevent rust.

examples.chinese: 晶莹水滴在阳光下闪烁光芒。
examples.pinyin: jīng yíng shuǐ dī zài yáng guāng xià shǎn shuò guāng máng.
examples.english: The clear droplets sparkle in sunlight.

examples.chinese: 星星发出微弱的光芒。
examples.pinyin: xīng xing fā chū wēi ruò de guāng máng.
examples.english: The stars give off a faint light.

examples.chinese: 走错方向，会妨碍大家准时到达。
examples.pinyin: zǒu cuò fāng xiàng, huì fáng ài dà jiā zhǔn shí dào dá.
examples.english: Going the wrong way will prevent everyone from arriving on time.

examples.chinese: 路上的积雪妨碍了交通。
examples.pinyin: lù shàng de jī xuě fáng ài le jiāo tōng.
examples.english: The snow on the road obstructed traffic.

examples.chinese: 他身体强壮，很少觉得疲倦。
examples.pinyin: tā shēn tǐ qiáng zhuàng, hěn shǎo jué de pí juàn.
examples.english: He is strong and rarely feels tired.

examples.chinese: 这匹马十分强壮。
examples.pinyin: zhè pǐ mǎ shí fēn qiáng zhuàng.
examples.english: This horse is very strong.

examples.chinese: 老师奖励了认真完成作业的孩子。
examples.pinyin: lǎo shī jiǎng lì le rèn zhēn wán chéng zuò yè de hái zi.
examples.english: The teacher rewarded the child who completed the homework carefully.

examples.chinese: 学校奖励了帮助同学的学生。
examples.pinyin: xué xiào jiǎng lì le bāng zhù tóng xué de xué sheng.
examples.english: The school rewarded the students who helped their classmates.

meaning: to long for; to yearn for

examples.chinese: 她向往平静的生活，不喜欢吵闹。
examples.pinyin: tā xiàng wǎng píng jìng de shēng huó, bù xǐ huan chǎo nào.
examples.english: She longs for a peaceful life and dislikes noise.

examples.chinese: 他一直向往海边的生活。
examples.pinyin: tā yī zhí xiàng wǎng hǎi biān de shēng huó.
examples.english: He has always longed for life by the sea.

meaning: to feel at ease; to stop worrying

examples.chinese: 母亲端来热姜汤，他终于放心休息。
examples.pinyin: mǔ qīn duān lái rè jiāng tāng, tā zhōng yú fàng xīn xiū xi.
examples.english: His mother brings hot ginger tea, and he relaxes.

examples.chinese: 孩子平安回家，她才放心。
examples.pinyin: hái zi píng ān huí jiā, tā cái fàng xīn.
examples.english: She only stopped worrying when the child came home safely.

examples.chinese: 得到原谅以后，他松了一口气。
examples.pinyin: dé dào yuán liàng yǐ hòu, tā sōng le yī kǒu qì.
examples.english: After being forgiven, he breathed a sigh of relief.

examples.chinese: 他请求朋友原谅自己的迟到。
examples.pinyin: tā qǐng qiú péng you yuán liàng zì jǐ de chí dào.
examples.english: He asked his friend to forgive him for being late.

examples.chinese: 比赛前，他的状态很好。
examples.pinyin: bǐ sài qián, tā de zhuàng tài hěn hǎo.
examples.english: He is in good form before the competition.

examples.chinese: 休息以后，他恢复了良好的状态。
examples.pinyin: xiū xi yǐ hòu, tā huī fù le liáng hǎo de zhuàng tài.
examples.english: After resting, he returned to good form.

examples.chinese: 快乐的孩子跟着音乐轻轻唱歌。
examples.pinyin: kuài lè de hái zi gēn zhe yīn yuè qīng qīng chàng gē.
examples.english: The happy child sang softly along with the music.

examples.chinese: 大家围着篝火唱歌。
examples.pinyin: dà jiā wéi zhe gōu huǒ chàng gē.
examples.english: Everyone sings around the bonfire.

examples.chinese: 国王详细询问了灾难的情况。
examples.pinyin: guó wáng xiáng xì xún wèn le zāi nàn de qíng kuàng.
examples.english: The king asked detailed questions about the disaster.

examples.chinese: 情况变得明朗后，他不再慌张。
examples.pinyin: qíng kuàng biàn de míng lǎng hòu, tā bù zài huāng zhāng.
examples.english: Once the situation became clear, he stopped panicking.

examples.chinese: 忘记朋友的名字，让他感到尴尬。
examples.pinyin: wàng jì péng you de míng zi, ràng tā gǎn dào gān gà.
examples.english: Forgetting his friend's name made him feel embarrassed.

examples.chinese: 他一时烜赫，却没有忘记老朋友。
examples.pinyin: tā yī shí xuǎn hè, què méi yǒu wàng jì lǎo péng you.
examples.english: Even at the height of his fame, he did not forget his old friends.

examples.chinese: 将领讨论保卫边疆的战略。
examples.pinyin: jiàng lǐng tǎo lùn bǎo wèi biān jiāng de zhàn lüè.
examples.english: The officers discuss strategies for defending the frontier.

examples.chinese: 将军重新调整了防守战略。
examples.pinyin: jiāng jūn chóng xīn tiáo zhěng le fáng shǒu zhàn lüè.
examples.english: The general revised the defensive strategy.

examples.chinese: 遇到困难不必因软弱而退却。
examples.pinyin: yù dào kùn nan bù bì yīn ruǎn ruò ér tuì què.
examples.english: Do not retreat from difficulties out of weakness.

examples.chinese: 他不愿在困难面前显得软弱。
examples.pinyin: tā bù yuàn zài kùn nan miàn qián xiǎn de ruǎn ruò.
examples.english: He does not want to appear weak in the face of difficulty.

examples.chinese: 虐待动物的人应该受到谴责。
examples.pinyin: nüè dài dòng wù de rén yīng gāi shòu dào qiǎn zé.
examples.english: People who abuse animals should be condemned.

examples.chinese: 他因虐待动物而受到处罚。
examples.pinyin: tā yīn nüè dài dòng wù ér shòu dào chǔ fá.
examples.english: He was punished for abusing animals.

examples.chinese: 商店禁止贩卖来源不明的药物。
examples.pinyin: shāng diàn jìn zhǐ fàn mài lái yuán bù míng de yào wù.
examples.english: The shop prohibits selling medicine of unknown origin.

examples.chinese: 这种药物需要妥善保存。
examples.pinyin: zhè zhǒng yào wù xū yào tuǒ shàn bǎo cún.
examples.english: This medication needs to be stored properly.

meaning: to clarify; to clear up a misunderstanding

examples.chinese: 她澄清了谣言，让大家放心。
examples.pinyin: tā chéng qīng le yáo yán, ràng dà jiā fàng xīn.
examples.english: She cleared up the rumor and reassured everyone.

examples.chinese: 他在会上澄清了误会。
examples.pinyin: tā zài huì shàng chéng qīng le wù huì.
examples.english: He cleared up the misunderstanding at the meeting.

meaning: even more; to a greater degree

examples.chinese: 编辑修改段落，使文章更加流畅。
examples.pinyin: biān jí xiū gǎi duàn luò, shǐ wén zhāng gèng jiā liú chàng.
examples.english: The editor revised the paragraphs to make the article flow better.

examples.chinese: 雨后的空气更加清新。
examples.pinyin: yǔ hòu de kōng qì gèng jiā qīng xīn.
examples.english: The air is even fresher after the rain.

examples.chinese: 他因帮助别人而感到光荣。
examples.pinyin: tā yīn bāng zhù bié ren ér gǎn dào guāng róng.
examples.english: He feels proud of helping others.

examples.chinese: 她认为帮助别人是一件光荣的事。
examples.pinyin: tā rèn wéi bāng zhù bié rén shì yī jiàn guāng róng de shì.
examples.english: She considers helping others an honorable thing.

examples.chinese: 不要盲目跟随，要先思考清楚。
examples.pinyin: bù yào máng mù gēn suí, yào xiān sī kǎo qīng chu.
examples.english: Do not follow blindly; think it through first.

examples.chinese: 不要盲目相信网上的消息。
examples.pinyin: bù yào máng mù xiāng xìn wǎng shàng de xiāo xi.
examples.english: Do not blindly believe information online.

meaning: to deal a blow to; to discourage

examples.chinese: 这次失败打击了他，但没有摧毁希望。
examples.pinyin: zhè cì shī bài dǎ jī le tā, dàn méi yǒu cuī huǐ xī wàng.
examples.english: This failure discouraged him without destroying his hope.

examples.chinese: 失败没有打击她继续努力的信心。
examples.pinyin: shī bài méi yǒu dǎ jī tā jì xù nǔ lì de xìn xīn.
examples.english: Failure did not shake her confidence in continuing to try.

examples.chinese: 他因打人受罚，开始反省行为。
examples.pinyin: tā yīn dǎ rén shòu fá, kāi shǐ fǎn xǐng xíng wéi.
examples.english: Punished for hitting someone, he reflects on his behavior.

examples.chinese: 吵架时也不能打人。
examples.pinyin: chǎo jià shí yě bù néng dǎ rén.
examples.english: You must not hit people even during an argument.

examples.chinese: 他找了半天，眼镜竟然在口袋里。
examples.pinyin: tā zhǎo le bàn tiān, yǎn jìng jìng rán zài kǒu dài lǐ.
examples.english: He searched for a long time, but his glasses turned out to be in his pocket.

examples.chinese: 看书时，他戴上了眼镜。
examples.pinyin: kàn shū shí, tā dài shàng le yǎn jìng.
examples.english: He puts on his glasses when reading.

examples.chinese: 他找了半天，眼镜竟然在口袋里。
examples.pinyin: tā zhǎo le bàn tiān, yǎn jìng jìng rán zài kǒu dài lǐ.
examples.english: He searched for a long time, but his glasses turned out to be in his pocket.

examples.chinese: 这么小的孩子竟然会下棋。
examples.pinyin: zhè me xiǎo de hái zi jìng rán huì xià qí.
examples.english: To my surprise, such a young child can play chess.

examples.chinese: 游泳可以锻炼肌肉，保持健康。
examples.pinyin: yóu yǒng kě yǐ duàn liàn jī ròu, bǎo chí jiàn kāng.
examples.english: Swimming can strengthen muscles and keep you healthy.

examples.chinese: 夏天我们常去游泳。
examples.pinyin: xià tiān wǒ men cháng qù yóu yǒng.
examples.english: We often go swimming in summer.

examples.chinese: 未经允许，不要进入私人住宅。
examples.pinyin: wèi jīng yǔn xǔ, bù yào jìn rù sī rén zhù zhái.
examples.english: Do not enter a private home without permission.

examples.chinese: 这条街上有许多私人住宅。
examples.pinyin: zhè tiáo jiē shàng yǒu xǔ duō sī rén zhù zhái.
examples.english: There are many private residences on this street.

examples.chinese: 这一百元是陌生人还给我的。
examples.pinyin: zhè yī bǎi yuán shì mò shēng rén huán gěi wǒ de.
examples.english: A stranger returned these one hundred yuan to me.

examples.chinese: 他孑然一身来到陌生的城市。
examples.pinyin: tā jié rán yī shēn lái dào mò shēng de chéng shì.
examples.english: He comes to an unfamiliar city all alone.

examples.chinese: 拍照结束后，她们一起去看戏剧。
examples.pinyin: pāi zhào jié shù hòu, tā men yī qǐ qù kàn xì jù.
examples.english: After taking photos, the women went to see a play together.

examples.chinese: 游客站在桥上拍照。
examples.pinyin: yóu kè zhàn zài qiáo shàng pāi zhào.
examples.english: The tourists stand on the bridge taking photographs.

examples.chinese: 手上绑着绷带，他仍然砰砰地敲门。
examples.pinyin: shǒu shàng bǎng zhe bēng dài, tā réng rán pēng pēng de qiāo mén.
examples.english: Even with his hand bandaged, he knocked loudly on the door.

examples.chinese: 护士换下了旧绷带。
examples.pinyin: hù shi huàn xià le jiù bēng dài.
examples.english: The nurse removed the old bandage.

meaning: to obtain; to receive; to get

examples.chinese: 离开监狱后，他重新获得了自由。
examples.pinyin: lí kāi jiān yù hòu, tā chóng xīn huò dé le zì yóu.
examples.english: After leaving prison, he regained his freedom.

examples.chinese: 他获得了优秀教师的头衔。
examples.pinyin: tā huò dé le yōu xiù jiào shī de tóu xián.
examples.english: He receives the title of outstanding teacher.

examples.chinese: 旺盛的好奇心驱使他征服高山。
examples.pinyin: wàng shèng de hào qí xīn qū shǐ tā zhēng fú gāo shān.
examples.english: Strong curiosity drives him to conquer the mountain.

examples.chinese: 登山队终于征服了这座高峰。
examples.pinyin: dēng shān duì zhōng yú zhēng fú le zhè zuò gāo fēng.
examples.english: The climbing team finally conquered this high peak.

examples.chinese: 主人真诚地邀请我留下来吃饭。
examples.pinyin: zhǔ rén zhēn chéng de yāo qǐng wǒ liú xià lái chī fàn.
examples.english: The host sincerely invited me to stay for a meal.

examples.chinese: 他真诚地向大家道歉。
examples.pinyin: tā zhēn chéng de xiàng dà jiā dào qiàn.
examples.english: He sincerely apologized to everyone.

examples.chinese: 降低声音后，大家能听清题目。
examples.pinyin: jiàng dī shēng yīn hòu, dà jiā néng tīng qīng tí mù.
examples.english: Once the volume was lowered, everyone could hear the question clearly.

examples.chinese: 他的声音变得嗄哑。
examples.pinyin: tā de shēng yīn biàn de shà yǎ.
examples.english: His voice becomes hoarse.

examples.chinese: 他赢得比赛，向大家露出微笑。
examples.pinyin: tā yíng dé bǐ sài, xiàng dà jiā lù chū wēi xiào.
examples.english: He won the competition and smiled at everyone.

examples.chinese: 她凭借努力赢得了比赛。
examples.pinyin: tā píng jiè nǔ lì yíng dé le bǐ sài.
examples.english: She wins the competition through hard work.

examples.chinese: 合并后的团队保留原有核心成员。
examples.pinyin: hé bìng hòu de tuán duì bǎo liú yuán yǒu hé xīn chéng yuán.
examples.english: The merged team keeps its original core members.

examples.chinese: 这两所学校明年将合并。
examples.pinyin: zhè liǎng suǒ xué xiào míng nián jiāng hé bìng.
examples.english: These two schools will merge next year.

examples.chinese: 绝对不能靠假设判断一个人的性格。
examples.pinyin: jué duì bù néng kào jiǎ shè pàn duàn yī gè rén de xìng gé.
examples.english: You must never judge someone's character on assumptions alone.

examples.chinese: 她的性格很开朗。
examples.pinyin: tā de xìng gé hěn kāi lǎng.
examples.english: She has a cheerful personality.

examples.chinese: 他颈部酸痛，不能使劲转头。
examples.pinyin: tā jǐng bù suān tòng, bù néng shǐ jìn zhuǎn tóu.
examples.english: His neck hurts, so he cannot turn his head forcefully.

examples.chinese: 门卡住了，他使劲推门。
examples.pinyin: mén qiǎ zhù le, tā shǐ jìn tuī mén.
examples.english: The door is stuck, so he pushes it hard.

meaning: one animal or certain single object

examples.chinese: 角落的鸟笼里有一只鹦鹉。
examples.pinyin: jiǎo luò de niǎo lóng lǐ yǒu yī zhī yīng wǔ.
examples.english: There is a parrot in the birdcage in the corner.

examples.chinese: 院子里跑来一只小猫。
examples.pinyin: yuàn zi lǐ pǎo lái yī zhī xiǎo māo.
examples.english: A kitten runs into the courtyard.

examples.pinyin: yī shēng jiě shì le nüè jí de zhèng zhuàng.
examples.english: The doctor explained the symptoms of malaria.

examples.pinyin: lǎo shī yòng tú huà jiě shì zhè ge guò chéng.
examples.english: The teacher explains this process with drawings.

examples.pinyin: yǎn yuán zài tái shàng yǎn yì wán bì guī zhào de gù shi.
examples.english: The actors perform the story of returning the jade intact to Zhao.

examples.chinese: 她用舞蹈演绎了这个传说。
examples.pinyin: tā yòng wǔ dǎo yǎn yì le zhè gè chuán shuō.
examples.english: She interpreted this legend through dance.

examples.pinyin: zhēn tàn fēn xī zhèng jù, chéng xiàn le wán zhěng de jīng guò.
examples.english: The detective analyzed the evidence and presented the full sequence of events.

examples.pinyin: zhào piàn chéng xiàn le chéng shì de biàn huà.
examples.english: The photographs reveal the changes in the city.

examples.pinyin: tā cóng è mèng zhōng tū rán xǐng lái.
examples.english: She suddenly woke from a nightmare.

examples.pinyin: wǒ jīn tiān hěn zǎo jiù xǐng lái le.
examples.english: I woke up very early today.

examples.english: As he passed the cave, he caught sight of a bat.

examples.english: I pass that bookshop on my way home.

examples.chinese: 这种类型的瓶子可以反复使用。

examples.english: This type of bottle can be reused repeatedly.

examples.chinese: 老师把硫磺放进标有名称的瓶子里。
examples.pinyin: lǎo shī bǎ liú huáng fàng jìn biāo yǒu míng chēng de píng zi lǐ.
examples.english: The teacher placed the sulfur in a labeled bottle.

examples.chinese: 我会铭记你的帮助，并且一定回报你。
examples.pinyin: wǒ huì míng jì nǐ de bāng zhù, bìng qiě yī dìng huí bào nǐ.
examples.english: I will remember your help and will certainly repay your kindness.

examples.english: This shop has low prices and attentive service.

examples.english: The soldiers remain alert to prevent a surprise attack by the enemy.

examples.pinyin: yè jiān zhí bān de rén bì xū bǎo chí jǐng tì.
examples.english: People on night duty must remain vigilant.

examples.chinese: 侦探分析证据，呈现了完整的经过。
examples.pinyin: zhēn tàn fēn xī zhèng jù, chéng xiàn le wán zhěng de jīng guò.
examples.english: The detective analyzed the evidence and presented the full sequence of events.

examples.chinese: 我们一起分析了实验结果。
examples.pinyin: wǒ men yī qǐ fēn xī le shí yàn jié guǒ.
examples.english: We analyzed the experimental results together.

examples.chinese: 工作人员正在登记来访者的姓名。
examples.pinyin: gōng zuò rén yuán zhèng zài dēng jì lái fǎng zhě de xìng míng.
examples.english: The staff are recording the visitors' names.

examples.chinese: 入住之前，请先登记姓名。
examples.pinyin: rù zhù zhī qián, qǐng xiān dēng jì xìng míng.
examples.english: Please register your name before checking in.

meaning: once; at some time in the past

examples.chinese: 他曾经特别害羞，现在很愿意交流。
examples.pinyin: tā céng jīng tè bié hài xiū, xiàn zài hěn yuàn yì jiāo liú.
examples.english: He used to be especially shy but now enjoys communicating.

examples.chinese: 我曾经住在这个小镇。
examples.pinyin: wǒ céng jīng zhù zài zhè gè xiǎo zhèn.
examples.english: I once lived in this small town.

examples.chinese: 这篇文章的层次很清楚。
examples.pinyin: zhè piān wén zhāng de céng cì hěn qīng chu.
examples.english: This article is clearly structured.

examples.chinese: 报告层次分明，容易理解。
examples.pinyin: bào gào céng cì fēn míng, róng yì lǐ jiě.
examples.english: The report is clearly organized and easy to understand.

examples.chinese: 桥梁在洪水中崩溃了。
examples.pinyin: qiáo liáng zài hóng shuǐ zhōng bēng kuì le.
examples.english: The bridge collapsed in the flood.

examples.chinese: 失去支撑后，整座建筑崩溃了。
examples.pinyin: shī qù zhī chēng hòu, zhěng zuò jiàn zhù bēng kuì le.
examples.english: The entire building collapsed after losing its support.

examples.chinese: 在关键时刻，她肯定能克服困难。
examples.pinyin: zài guān jiàn shí kè, tā kěn dìng néng kè fú kùn nan.
examples.english: At the crucial moment, she will surely overcome the difficulty.

examples.chinese: 认真准备后，你肯定能做好。
examples.pinyin: rèn zhēn zhǔn bèi hòu, nǐ kěn dìng néng zuò hǎo.
examples.english: With careful preparation, you can certainly do it well.

meaning: to get; to obtain; to receive

examples.chinese: 得到原谅以后，他松了一口气。
examples.pinyin: dé dào yuán liàng yǐ hòu, tā sōng le yī kǒu qì.
examples.english: After being forgiven, he breathed a sigh of relief.

examples.chinese: 孩子跟随老师，也得到家人的支持。
examples.pinyin: hái zi gēn suí lǎo shī, yě dé dào jiā rén de zhī chí.
examples.english: The child follows the teacher's guidance and also receives support from the family.

examples.chinese: 在关键时刻，她肯定能克服困难。
examples.pinyin: zài guān jiàn shí kè, tā kěn dìng néng kè fú kùn nan.
examples.english: At the crucial moment, she will surely overcome the difficulty.

examples.chinese: 他们共同克服了困难。
examples.pinyin: tā men gòng tóng kè fú le kùn nan.
examples.english: They overcame the difficulties together.

examples.chinese: 他对这个答案感到疑惑。
examples.pinyin: tā duì zhè ge dá àn gǎn dào yí huò.
examples.english: He felt puzzled by this answer.

examples.pinyin: zhè gè jiě shì méi yǒu xiāo chú tā de yí huò.
examples.english: This explanation did not remove his doubts.

examples.chinese: 受到惩罚以后，他承认自己做错了。
examples.pinyin: shòu dào chéng fá yǐ hòu, tā chéng rèn zì jǐ zuò cuò le.

examples.pinyin: wéi fǎn guī dìng de rén shòu dào le chéng fá.

examples.english: She is a competent manager.

examples.chinese: 受到惩罚以后，他承认自己做错了。
examples.pinyin: shòu dào chéng fá yǐ hòu, tā chéng rèn zì jǐ zuò cuò le.

examples.pinyin: tā kuáng wàng de dèng yǎn, bù kěn chéng rèn cuò wù.
examples.english: He glares arrogantly and refuses to admit his mistake.

examples.english: The water rises rapidly, giving him a sudden fright.

examples.english: He winks at his friend to show agreement.

examples.english: This sentence fits here very well.

examples.pinyin: zhè gè lì zi hěn qià dàng.
examples.english: This example is very appropriate.

examples.pinyin: tóng xué zhī jiān xiāng chǔ dé shí fēn róng qià.

examples.pinyin: pǎo wán bù, tā de liǎn sè hóng rùn.

examples.pinyin: qián shuǐ shí, tā fā xiàn le chén chuán de cán hái.

examples.english: I dislike deception, especially lies involving money.

examples.english: She is photographing the scenery by the lake.

examples.chinese: 拍摄时，水已淹没了半个村庄。
examples.pinyin: pāi shè shí, shuǐ yǐ yān mò le bàn ge cūn zhuāng.
examples.english: During filming, water had already flooded half the village.

examples.pinyin: hóng shuǐ yān mò le dī chù de nóng tián.
examples.english: The flood submerged the low-lying farmland.

examples.pinyin: zhù zài jiāo qū de péng you jīng cháng jiāo liú yǎng huā jīng yàn.
examples.english: Friends living in the suburbs often exchange gardening tips.

examples.chinese: 他在实践中积累了经验。
examples.pinyin: tā zài shí jiàn zhōng jī lěi le jīng yàn.
examples.english: He gained experience through practice.

examples.chinese: 她谦虚地向老师请教。
examples.pinyin: tā qiān xū de xiàng lǎo shī qǐng jiào.
examples.english: She humbly asked the teacher for advice.

examples.pinyin: tā qǔ dé hǎo chéng jì hòu réng rán hěn qiān xū.
examples.english: He remains modest after achieving good results.

examples.pinyin: huǎng yán diàn wū le tā de míng shēng.
examples.english: The lies tarnished his reputation.

examples.pinyin: bù chéng shí de xíng wéi diàn wū le tuán duì de míng yù.
examples.english: Dishonest behavior tarnished the team's reputation.

examples.pinyin: tā wèi zì jǐ de chí dào xiàng lǎo shī dào qiàn.
examples.english: He apologized to the teacher for being late.

examples.pinyin: tā wèi dǎ duàn tán huà ér dào qiàn.
examples.english: She apologizes for interrupting the conversation.

meaning: to miss; to think of fondly

examples.pinyin: wǒ bǎ diàn zi fàng hǎo, tǎng xià xiǎng niàn jiā rén.

examples.pinyin: tā yī lù dié dié bù xiū de jiǎng zhe gù shi.
examples.english: He tells stories nonstop throughout the journey.

examples.pinyin: tā dié dié bù xiū de tán lùn zì jǐ de xīn chē.
examples.english: He chatters endlessly about his new car.

examples.chinese: 请协助整理文件，别耽误会议。
examples.pinyin: qǐng xié zhù zhěng lǐ wén jiàn, bié dān wu huì yì.

examples.pinyin: zhì yuàn zhě xié zhù lǎo rén tián xiě biǎo gé.
examples.english: The volunteer helps the old man fill in the form.

examples.pinyin: qǐng xié zhù zhěng lǐ wén jiàn, bié dān wu huì yì.
examples.english: Please help organize the documents so the meeting is not delayed.

examples.pinyin: dà yǔ dān wu le wǒ men de xíng chéng.
examples.english: The heavy rain delayed our journey.

examples.pinyin: hái zi men zài lín zhōng tàn suǒ zì rán.
examples.english: The children explore nature in the woods.

examples.pinyin: tā men zhèng zài tàn suǒ dòng xué shēn chù.
examples.english: They are exploring the depths of the cave.

examples.english: The magnificent scenery left her awestruck.

examples.pinyin: méi gǎn shàng zuì hòu yī bān chē, tā gǎn dào yí hàn.

examples.pinyin: gǔ shū lǐ, kù kě yǐ biǎo shì kù zi.
examples.english: In ancient books, this character can mean trousers.
