examples.pinyin: bié ná zhè xiē jiè kǒu táng sè wǒ.
examples.english: Do not fob me off with these excuses.

examples.chinese: 古文中的逖，可以表示遥远。
examples.pinyin: gǔ wén zhōng de tì, kě yǐ biǎo shì yáo yuǎn.
examples.english: In classical writing, this character can mean distant.

examples.chinese: 注释说逖有遥远之意。
examples.pinyin: zhù shì shuō tì yǒu yáo yuǎn zhī yì.
examples.english: The annotation says ti means far away.

examples.chinese: 他举止猥琐，大家都躲着他。
examples.pinyin: tā jǔ zhǐ wěi suǒ, dà jiā dōu duǒ zhe tā.
examples.english: His behavior was sleazy, and everyone avoided him.

examples.chinese: 这种猥琐的举止令人不适。
examples.pinyin: zhè zhǒng wěi suǒ de jǔ zhǐ lìng rén bù shì.
examples.english: This vulgar behavior makes people uncomfortable.

examples.chinese: 他捂住耳朵，躲开刺耳的声音。
examples.pinyin: tā wǔ zhù ěr duo, duǒ kāi cì ěr de shēng yīn.
examples.english: He covered his ears to avoid the piercing sound.

examples.chinese: 她用手捂住了嘴。
examples.pinyin: tā yòng shǒu wǔ zhù le zuǐ.
examples.english: She covers her mouth with her hand.

examples.chinese: 鉴定以后，这幅画被认定为赝品。
examples.pinyin: jiàn dìng yǐ hòu, zhè fú huà bèi rèn dìng wéi yàn pǐn.
examples.english: After examination, this painting was judged to be a forgery.

examples.chinese: 专家认为这件瓷器是赝品。
examples.pinyin: zhuān jiā rèn wéi zhè jiàn cí qì shì yàn pǐn.
examples.english: The expert believes this porcelain is a fake.

examples.chinese: 他佯装镇定，手却微微发抖。
examples.pinyin: tā yáng zhuāng zhèn dìng, shǒu què wēi wēi fā dǒu.
examples.english: He pretended to be calm, but his hands trembled slightly.

examples.chinese: 她佯装没听见，继续看书。
examples.pinyin: tā yáng zhuāng méi tīng jiàn, jì xù kàn shū.
examples.english: She pretends not to hear and continues reading.

examples.chinese: 他被朋友揶揄，脸一下红了。
examples.pinyin: tā bèi péng you yé yú, liǎn yī xià hóng le.
examples.english: He blushed when his friends teased him.

examples.chinese: 朋友揶揄他总是迟到。
examples.pinyin: péng you yé yú tā zǒng shì chí dào.
examples.english: His friend teases him for always being late.

examples.chinese: 午后的猫显得十分慵懒。
examples.pinyin: wǔ hòu de māo xiǎn de shí fēn yōng lǎn.
examples.english: The cat seemed very lazy in the afternoon.

examples.chinese: 她慵懒地靠在沙发上。
examples.pinyin: tā yōng lǎn de kào zài shā fā shàng.
examples.english: She leans languidly on the sofa.

examples.chinese: 修桥的钱终于有了着落。
examples.pinyin: xiū qiáo de qián zhōng yú yǒu le zhuó luò.
examples.english: Funding for the bridge repairs was finally secured.

examples.chinese: 项目的资金已有着落。
examples.pinyin: xiàng mù de zī jīn yǐ yǒu zhuó luò.
examples.english: The project now has an assured funding source.

examples.chinese: 大家一起走啵。
examples.pinyin: dà jiā yī qǐ zǒu bo.
examples.english: Let's all go together.

examples.chinese: 坐下来歇会儿啵。
examples.pinyin: zuò xià lái xiē huì ér bo.
examples.english: Sit down and rest for a moment.

examples.chinese: 好嘞，我马上来。
examples.pinyin: hǎo lei, wǒ mǎ shàng lái.
examples.english: All right, I will be right there.

examples.chinese: 行嘞，这就给你拿。
examples.pinyin: xíng lei, zhè jiù gěi nǐ ná.
examples.english: Okay, I'll get it for you now.

examples.chinese: 她噘嘴说自己不想走。
examples.pinyin: tā juē zuǐ shuō zì jǐ bù xiǎng zǒu.
examples.english: She pouted and said she did not want to leave.

examples.chinese: 小孩噘嘴表示不满。
examples.pinyin: xiǎo hái juē zuǐ biǎo shì bù mǎn.
examples.english: The child pouts to show displeasure.

examples.chinese: 他噌地一下站了起来。
examples.pinyin: tā cēng de yī xià zhàn le qǐ lai.
examples.english: He suddenly sprang to his feet.

examples.chinese: 小猫噌地跳上窗台。
examples.pinyin: xiǎo māo cēng de tiào shàng chuāng tái.
examples.english: The kitten jumped onto the windowsill in a flash.

examples.chinese: 其中的困难不少，个中原因需要调查。
examples.pinyin: qí zhōng de kùn nan bù shǎo, gè zhōng yuán yīn xū yào diào chá.
examples.english: There are many difficulties, and the underlying reasons need investigating.

examples.chinese: 我还不明白个中缘由。
examples.pinyin: wǒ hái bù míng bai gè zhōng yuán yóu.
examples.english: I still do not understand the reasons behind it.

examples.chinese: 请不要传播毁谤他人的话。
examples.pinyin: qǐng bù yào chuán bō huǐ bàng tā rén de huà.
examples.english: Please do not spread slander about other people.

examples.chinese: 他拒绝参与毁谤同事。
examples.pinyin: tā jù jué cān yù huǐ bàng tóng shì.
examples.english: He refused to join in slandering a colleague.

examples.chinese: 他的兴奋达到了极点。
examples.pinyin: tā de xīng fèn dá dào le jí diǎn.
examples.english: His excitement reached its peak.

examples.chinese: 他的耐心已到极点。
examples.pinyin: tā de nài xīn yǐ dào jí diǎn.
examples.english: His patience has reached its limit.

examples.chinese: 他向来守时，今天也没有迟到。
examples.pinyin: tā xiàng lái shǒu shí, jīn tiān yě méi yǒu chí dào.
examples.english: He has always been punctual and was not late today either.

examples.chinese: 她向来不喝咖啡。
examples.pinyin: tā xiàng lái bù hē kā fēi.
examples.english: She has always avoided coffee.

examples.chinese: 任何人都不应该逾越法律的界限。
examples.pinyin: rèn hé rén dōu bù yīng gāi yú yuè fǎ lǜ de jiè xiàn.
examples.english: No one should go beyond the boundaries of the law.

examples.chinese: 你不能逾越自己的权限。
examples.pinyin: nǐ bù néng yú yuè zì jǐ de quán xiàn.
examples.english: You cannot overstep your authority.

examples.chinese: 认真钻研以后，他学会使用电钻。
examples.pinyin: rèn zhēn zuān yán yǐ hòu, tā xué huì shǐ yòng diàn zuàn.
examples.english: After studying carefully, he learned to use an electric drill.

examples.chinese: 她花了几年钻研古文字。
examples.pinyin: tā huā le jǐ nián zuān yán gǔ wén zì.
examples.english: She spent several years studying ancient writing deeply.

examples.chinese: 字典把呒解释为惊讶的样子。
examples.pinyin: zì diǎn bǎ fǔ jiě shì wéi jīng yà de yàng zi.
examples.english: The dictionary explains this character as expressing astonishment.

examples.chinese: 注释把呒释为惊讶。
examples.pinyin: zhù shì bǎ fǔ shì wéi jīng yà.
examples.english: The annotation defines fu as astonished.

examples.chinese: 蛇吐着舌头，发出咝咝声。
examples.pinyin: shé tǔ zhe shé tou, fā chū sī sī shēng.
examples.english: The snake flicked its tongue and hissed.

examples.chinese: 水壶发出咝咝的响声。
examples.pinyin: shuǐ hú fā chū sī sī de xiǎng shēng.
examples.english: The kettle makes a hissing sound.

examples.chinese: 他用竹筒从水桶里舀水。
examples.pinyin: tā yòng zhú tǒng cóng shuǐ tǒng lǐ yǎo shuǐ.
examples.english: He scoops water from the bucket with a bamboo tube.

examples.chinese: 这个竹筒可以用来装笔。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge zhú tǒng kě yǐ yòng lái zhuāng bǐ.
examples.english: This bamboo tube can hold pens.

meaning: glutinous rice and choice of filling wrapped in leaves and steamed or boiled

examples.chinese: 打开粽子，浓郁的香气扑鼻。
examples.pinyin: dǎ kāi zòng zi, nóng yù de xiāng qì pū bí.
examples.english: The rice dumpling releases a rich aroma.

examples.chinese: 她用糯米包粽子。
examples.pinyin: tā yòng nuò mǐ bāo zòng zi.
examples.english: She wraps rice dumplings using glutinous rice.

meaning: Describes capturing a target that has no way to escape.

examples.chinese: 逃犯已被包围，警方瓮中捉鳖。
examples.pinyin: táo fàn yǐ bèi bāo wéi, jǐng fāng wèng zhōng zhuō biē.
examples.english: The police surround the fugitive and catch him easily.

examples.chinese: 出口全被守住，对方只能被瓮中捉鳖。
examples.pinyin: Chū kǒu quán bèi shǒu zhù, duì fāng zhǐ néng bèi wèng zhōng zhuō biē.
examples.english: With every exit guarded, the other side could only be caught in the trap.

examples.chinese: 古人用俸禄养家，也祈求福禄。
examples.pinyin: gǔ rén yòng fèng lù yǎng jiā, yě qí qiú fú lù.
examples.english: People lived on official pay and prayed for blessings.

examples.chinese: 寿宴上，大家祝老人福禄双全。
examples.pinyin: shòu yàn shàng, dà jiā zhù lǎo rén fú lù shuāng quán.
examples.english: At the birthday banquet, everyone wishes the elder good fortune and prosperity.

examples.chinese: 她蹙眉不语，一直忧心忡忡。
examples.pinyin: tā cù méi bù yǔ, yī zhí yōu xīn chōng chōng.
examples.english: She frowns silently, full of worry.

examples.chinese: 他看着复杂的题目，不禁蹙眉。
examples.pinyin: Tā kàn zhe fù zá de tí mù, bù jīn cù méi.
examples.english: He looked at the difficult question and could not help frowning.

examples.chinese: 院中的菊花散发馥郁香气。
examples.pinyin: yuàn zhōng de jú huā sàn fā fù yù xiāng qì.
examples.english: The chrysanthemums fill the yard with fragrance.

examples.chinese: 花园里玫瑰的香气十分馥郁。
examples.pinyin: Huā yuán lǐ méi gui de xiāng qì shí fēn fù yù.
examples.english: The scent of the roses in the garden is intensely fragrant.

examples.chinese: 他跟从师傅练习，巩固手艺。
examples.pinyin: tā gēn cóng shī fu liàn xí, gǒng gù shǒu yì.
examples.english: He follows his master's lessons to improve his craft.

examples.chinese: 学徒跟从师傅到外地学习。
examples.pinyin: Xué tú gēn cóng shī fu dào wài dì xué xí.
examples.english: The apprentice followed the master to study elsewhere.

examples.chinese: 古文中的从兄弟指堂兄弟。
examples.pinyin: gǔ wén zhōng de cóng xiōng dì zhǐ táng xiōng dì.
examples.english: In classical Chinese, this term means paternal cousins.

examples.chinese: 族谱记载他有三位从兄弟。
examples.pinyin: zú pǔ jì zǎi tā yǒu sān wèi cóng xiōng dì.
examples.english: The family genealogy records three male paternal cousins for him.

examples.chinese: 旭日初升，他睡眼惺忪地起床。
examples.pinyin: xù rì chū shēng, tā shuì yǎn xīng sōng de qǐ chuáng.
examples.english: He rises sleepily as the sun comes up.

examples.chinese: 孩子睡眼惺忪地走出房间。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi shuì yǎn xīng sōng de zǒu chū fáng jiān.
examples.english: The child walked out of the room with sleepy eyes.

examples.chinese: 她举止雍容，客人恭敬行礼。
examples.pinyin: tā jǔ zhǐ yōng róng, kè rén gōng jìng xíng lǐ.
examples.english: She carries herself gracefully, and the guests bow respectfully.

examples.chinese: 她雍容地走上台，向观众致意。
examples.pinyin: Tā yōng róng de zǒu shàng tái, xiàng guān zhòng zhì yì.
examples.english: She walked onto the stage with dignity and greeted the audience.

examples.chinese: 照片留下了演员年轻时的丰采。
examples.pinyin: zhào piàn liú xià le yǎn yuán nián qīng shí de fēng cǎi.
examples.english: The photograph captures the actor's youthful grace.

examples.chinese: 画家在肖像中保留了她的丰采。
examples.pinyin: Huà jiā zài xiào xiàng zhōng bǎo liú le tā de fēng cǎi.
examples.english: The painter preserved her graceful bearing in the portrait.

meaning: Describes a tiny part of an immensely larger whole.

examples.chinese: 个人的力量如同沧海一粟。
examples.pinyin: gè rén de lì liàng rú tóng cāng hǎi yī sù.
examples.english: One person's power is like a grain in the vast sea.

examples.chinese: 和整个宇宙相比，地球只是沧海一粟。
examples.pinyin: Hé zhěng ge yǔ zhòu xiāng bǐ, Dì qiú zhǐ shì cāng hǎi yí sù.
examples.english: Compared with the whole universe, Earth is only a tiny part of a vast whole.

examples.chinese: 他平日勤于属文，常去书局购书。
examples.pinyin: tā píng rì qín yú zhǔ wén, cháng qù shū jú gòu shū.
examples.english: He writes diligently and often buys books at a bookshop.

examples.chinese: 他在书房属文，直到深夜才停笔。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài shū fáng zhǔ wén, zhí dào shēn yè cái tíng bǐ.
examples.english: He wrote in his study and did not put down his pen until late at night.

examples.chinese: 工人在堤坝旁的路面洒水。
examples.pinyin: gōng rén zài dī bà páng de lù miàn sǎ shuǐ.
examples.english: The worker sprinkles water on the road beside the dam.

examples.chinese: 雨季之前，村民加固了堤坝。
examples.pinyin: Yǔ jì zhī qián, cūn mín jiā gù le dī bà.
examples.english: Before the rainy season, the villagers reinforced the dike.

examples.chinese: 古人把丰收看作神祇的恩赐。
examples.pinyin: gǔ rén bǎ fēng shōu kàn zuò shén qí de ēn cì.
examples.english: Ancient people saw a good harvest as a gift from the gods.

examples.chinese: 壁画中描绘了几位神祇。
examples.pinyin: Bì huà zhōng miáo huì le jǐ wèi shén qí.
examples.english: Several deities are depicted in the mural.

meaning: Describes many achievements or productive results.

examples.chinese: 秋天的果园枝头果实累累。
examples.pinyin: qiū tiān de guǒ yuán zhī tóu guǒ shí léi léi.
examples.english: The orchard's branches are laden with fruit in autumn.

examples.chinese: 研究团队多年合作，如今已经果实累累。
examples.pinyin: yán jiū tuán duì duō nián hé zuò, rú jīn yǐ jīng guǒ shí léi léi.
examples.english: After years of collaboration, the research team now has many achievements.

meaning: Describes deep parental love for one's children.

examples.chinese: 她替孩子整理下摆，舐犊情深。
examples.pinyin: tā tì hái zi zhěng lǐ xià bǎi, shì dú qíng shēn.
examples.english: She tenderly straightens her child's hem.

examples.chinese: 信中处处流露出父亲的舐犊情深。
examples.pinyin: Xìn zhōng chù chù liú lù chū fù qīn de shì dú qíng shēn.
examples.english: The letter shows the father's deep affection for his child throughout.

examples.chinese: 他先付定金，尔后委托工匠制作。
examples.pinyin: tā xiān fù dìng jīn, ěr hòu wěi tuō gōng jiàng zhì zuò.
examples.english: He pays a deposit and then commissions the craftsman.

examples.chinese: 他先完成作业，尔后出去散步。
examples.pinyin: Tā xiān wán chéng zuò yè, ěr hòu chū qù sàn bù.
examples.english: He finishes his homework first and goes for a walk afterwards.

examples.chinese: 这首歌遐迩闻名，曾风靡一时。
examples.pinyin: zhè shǒu gē xiá ěr wén míng, céng fēng mǐ yī shí.
examples.english: The song is widely known and was once immensely popular.

examples.chinese: 这座古塔遐迩闻名。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò gǔ tǎ xiá'ěr wén míng.
examples.english: This ancient pagoda is known far and wide.

examples.chinese: 古画中的婢女跪下递上茶杯。
examples.pinyin: gǔ huà zhōng de bì nǚ guì xia dì shàng chá bēi.
examples.english: The maid in the old painting kneels to present tea.

examples.chinese: 小说里的婢女替主人整理衣服。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo shuō lǐ de bì nǚ tì zhǔ rén zhěng lǐ yī fu.
examples.english: The female servant in the novel arranges her employer's clothes.

examples.chinese: 故事中的人物因绝望而自缢。
examples.pinyin: gù shi zhōng de rén wù yīn jué wàng ér zì yì.
examples.english: The character in the story hangs himself in despair.

examples.chinese: 古书中的嗌喉指自缢。
examples.pinyin: gǔ shū zhōng de ài hóu zhǐ zì yì.
examples.english: In old writing, 嗌喉 refers to dying by hanging oneself.

examples.chinese: 诗中的伊人仿佛近在咫尺。
examples.pinyin: shī zhōng de yī rén fǎng fú jìn zài zhǐ chǐ.
examples.english: The beloved in the poem seems only a step away.

examples.chinese: 诗人隔着河水思念伊人。
examples.pinyin: Shī rén gé zhe hé shuǐ sī niàn yī rén.
examples.english: The poet longs for the beloved across the river.

meaning: Describes agreeing submissively without independent judgment.

examples.chinese: 他虽外表斯文，却并非唯唯诺诺。
examples.pinyin: tā suī wài biǎo sī wen, què bìng fēi wéi wéi nuò nuò.
examples.english: He looks refined but does not simply agree with everyone.

examples.chinese: 讨论时，他只会唯唯诺诺。
examples.pinyin: Tǎo lùn shí, tā zhǐ huì wéi wéi nuò nuò.
examples.english: During the discussion, he only agrees submissively with everything.

examples.chinese: 这本诗歌集荟萃了多位名家作品。
examples.pinyin: zhè běn shī gē jí huì cuì le duō wèi míng jiā zuò pǐn.
examples.english: The poetry collection gathers works by several noted writers.

examples.chinese: 这场展览荟萃了许多优秀作品。
examples.pinyin: Zhè chǎng zhǎn lǎn huì cuì le xǔ duō yōu xiù zuò pǐn.
examples.english: This exhibition brings together many outstanding works.

examples.chinese: 长年使用棒槌和铁椎使手生胼胝。
examples.pinyin: cháng nián shǐ yòng bàng chuí hé tiě chuí shǐ shǒu shēng pián zhī.
examples.english: Years of using wooden and iron mallets leave his hands calloused.

examples.chinese: 他的手掌上有几处胼胝。
examples.pinyin: Tā de shǒu zhǎng shàng yǒu jǐ chù pián zhī.
examples.english: There are several calluses on his palms.

meaning: crack into a network of fissures

examples.chinese: 围墙颓圮，地面也已干旱龟裂。
examples.pinyin: wéi qiáng tuí pǐ, dì miàn yě yǐ gān hàn jūn liè.
examples.english: The wall has collapsed, and the dry ground is cracked.

examples.chinese: 太阳晒了很久，泥地开始龟裂。
examples.pinyin: Tài yáng shài le hěn jiǔ, ní dì kāi shǐ jūn liè.
examples.english: After a long time in the sun, the muddy ground began to crack.

meaning: Describes bad circumstances giving way to better times.

examples.chinese: 度过困难以后，他终于否极泰来。
examples.pinyin: dù guò kùn nan yǐ hòu, tā zhōng yú pǐ jí tài lái.
examples.english: After enduring hardship, his fortunes finally improved.

examples.chinese: 熬过艰难的几年，他们终于否极泰来。
examples.pinyin: Áo guò jiān nán de jǐ nián, tā men zhōng yú pǐ jí tài lái.
examples.english: After enduring several hard years, their fortunes finally improved.

examples.chinese: 发霉的气味让住客十分腻烦。
examples.pinyin: fā méi de qì wèi ràng zhù kè shí fēn nì fan.
examples.english: The musty smell greatly annoys the guest.

examples.chinese: 每天听同样的抱怨，他早已腻烦。
examples.pinyin: Měi tiān tīng tóng yàng de bào yuàn, tā zǎo yǐ nì fan.
examples.english: He has long been fed up with hearing the same complaints every day.

examples.chinese: 古文中的暨今表示直到现在。
examples.pinyin: gǔ wén zhōng de jì jīn biǎo shì zhí dào xiàn zài.
examples.english: In classical writing, this expression means up to now.

examples.chinese: 这段碑文以暨今说明传统延续到了撰文之时。
examples.pinyin: Zhè duàn bēi wén yǐ jì jīn shuō míng chuán tǒng yán xù dào le zhuàn wén zhī shí.
examples.english: The inscription uses 暨今 to show that the tradition continued up to the time of writing.

examples.chinese: 他挑起眉毛，对谎话报以嗤笑。
examples.pinyin: tā tiǎo qǐ méi mao, duì huǎng huà bào yǐ chī xiào.
examples.english: He raises an eyebrow and scoffs at the lie.

examples.chinese: 面对质疑，他只是嗤笑，没有解释。
examples.pinyin: Miàn duì zhì yí, tā zhǐ shì chī xiào, méi yǒu jiě shì.
examples.english: Faced with doubts, he merely scoffed without explaining.

examples.chinese: 双方长期对峙，贻误和谈时机。
examples.pinyin: shuāng fāng cháng qī duì zhì, yí wù hé tán shí jī.
examples.english: The prolonged standoff causes both sides to miss a chance for peace.

examples.chinese: 反复争论贻误了出发的时机。
examples.pinyin: Fǎn fù zhēng lùn yí wù le chū fā de shí jī.
examples.english: Repeated arguments caused them to miss the right moment to depart.

examples.chinese: 到了巳时，街市已熙熙攘攘。
examples.pinyin: dào le sì shí, jiē shì yǐ xī xī rǎng rǎng.
examples.english: By the late morning, the market is bustling.

examples.chinese: 古文写道，客人在巳时到达。
examples.pinyin: Gǔ wén xiě dào, kè rén zài sì shí dào dá.
examples.english: The classical text says the guests arrived during the Si hour.

examples.chinese: 他仗恃家财，要求别人伺候。
examples.pinyin: tā zhàng shì jiā cái, yāo qiú bié ren cì hou.
examples.english: He relies on his wealth and demands others serve him.

examples.chinese: 他仗恃家里的关系，不肯认真工作。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhàng shì jiā lǐ de guān xi, bù kěn rèn zhēn gōng zuò.
examples.english: He relies arrogantly on his family's connections and will not work seriously.

meaning: it is over; that is the end

examples.chinese: 他喟叹一声，说往事已矣。
examples.pinyin: tā kuì tàn yī shēng, shuō wǎng shì yǐ yǐ.
examples.english: He sighs deeply and says the past is over.

examples.chinese: 他叹道，此事已矣。
examples.pinyin: tā tàn dào, cǐ shì yǐ yǐ.
examples.english: He sighs, saying that this matter is over.

examples.chinese: 他勤读古籍，有韦编三绝的精神。
examples.pinyin: tā qín dú gǔ jí, yǒu wéi biān sān jué de jīng shen.
examples.english: He studies ancient books with tireless dedication.

examples.chinese: 老师用韦编三绝勉励学生勤读。
examples.pinyin: Lǎo shī yòng wéi biān sān jué miǎn lì xué sheng qín dú.
examples.english: The teacher uses the allusion 韦编三绝 to encourage diligent reading.

examples.chinese: 岂能因一次失败就妄自菲薄。
examples.pinyin: qǐ néng yīn yī cì shī bài jiù wàng zì fěi bó.
examples.english: How can one failure justify belittling yourself?

examples.chinese: 不要因为暂时落后就妄自菲薄。
examples.pinyin: Bú yào yīn wèi zàn shí luò hòu jiù wàng zì fěi bó.
examples.english: Do not belittle yourself because you are temporarily behind.

meaning: put on or wear a shirt

examples.chinese: 初一清晨，他着衫出门拜年。
examples.pinyin: chū yī qīng chén, tā zhuó shān chū mén bài nián.
examples.english: He dresses and goes out to give New Year greetings.

examples.chinese: 他着衫束带，准备迎客。
examples.pinyin: tā zhuó shān shù dài, zhǔn bèi yíng kè.
examples.english: He puts on a shirt and ties his sash, ready to welcome guests.

meaning: yamen, government office in dynastic China

examples.chinese: 旧时衙门的判决也受舆论关注。
examples.pinyin: jiù shí yá men de pàn jué yě shòu yú lùn guān zhù.
examples.english: Even in the past, official judgments drew public attention.

examples.chinese: 古代胥吏办理衙门的杂务。
examples.pinyin: gǔ dài xū lì bàn lǐ yá men de zá wù.
examples.english: Ancient clerks handled routine work in government offices.

meaning: Describes showing concern for someone's daily well-being.

examples.chinese: 朋友嘘寒问暖，使她不再空虚。
examples.pinyin: péng you xū hán wèn nuǎn, shǐ tā bù zài kōng xū.
examples.english: Her friend's caring inquiries ease her emptiness.

examples.chinese: 邻居常来嘘寒问暖，让老人很感动。
examples.pinyin: Lín jū cháng lái xū hán wèn nuǎn, ràng lǎo rén hěn gǎn dòng.
examples.english: The neighbors often ask after the elderly person's well-being, which touches them deeply.

examples.chinese: 十除以三，得到的余数是一。
examples.pinyin: shí chú yǐ sān, dé dào de yú shù shì yī.
examples.english: Ten divided by three leaves a remainder of one.

examples.chinese: 古文中的仂，有余数的意思。
examples.pinyin: gǔ wén zhōng de lè, yǒu yú shù de yì si.
examples.english: In classical writing, this character can mean a remainder.

examples.chinese: 尉迟与吕氏都是姓氏称呼。
examples.pinyin: yù chí yǔ lǚ shì dōu shì xìng shì chēng hu.
examples.english: Yuchi and Lü are both surnames.

examples.chinese: 这部族谱记述吕氏的迁居历史。
examples.pinyin: zhè bù zú pǔ jì shù lǚ shì de qiān jū lì shǐ.
examples.english: This genealogy records the Lü family's migration history.

examples.chinese: 她伫立在门口，阻止小狗跑出去。
examples.pinyin: tā zhù lì zài mén kǒu, zǔ zhǐ xiǎo gǒu pǎo chū qù.
examples.english: She stood at the door to keep the puppy from running out.

examples.chinese: 他在岸边伫立，望着远去的船。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài àn biān zhù lì, wàng zhe yuǎn qù de chuán.
examples.english: He stands on the shore for a while, watching the departing boat.

examples.chinese: 古文劝诫汝等不要越俎代庖。
examples.pinyin: gǔ wén quàn jiè rǔ děng bù yào yuè zǔ dài páo.
examples.english: The classical passage warns you not to take over others' duties.

examples.chinese: 汝等应当谨守诺言。
examples.pinyin: rǔ děng yīng dāng jǐn shǒu nuò yán.
examples.english: You all should carefully keep your promises.

examples.chinese: 一群猴子盘踞在空置别墅里。
examples.pinyin: yī qún hóu zi pán jù zài kōng zhì bié shù lǐ.
examples.english: A troop of monkeys occupies the empty villa.

examples.chinese: 故事里的强盗盘踞在古堡中。
examples.pinyin: Gù shi lǐ de qiáng dào pán jù zài gǔ bǎo zhōng.
examples.english: The bandits in the story occupy the old castle.

examples.chinese: 账簿上的数字不能胡乱涂改。
examples.pinyin: zhàng bù shàng de shù zì bù néng hú luàn tú gǎi.
examples.english: The figures in the ledger must not be altered carelessly.

examples.chinese: 答案有错，可以划掉再写，不要胡乱涂改。
examples.pinyin: Dá àn yǒu cuò, kě yǐ huà diào zài xiě, bú yào hú luàn tú gǎi.
examples.english: If an answer is wrong, cross it out and rewrite it rather than altering it carelessly.

examples.chinese: 吾辈应踏实做事，不可沽名钓誉。
examples.pinyin: wú bèi yīng tā shi zuò shì, bù kě gū míng diào yù.
examples.english: We should work honestly instead of seeking empty fame.

examples.chinese: 吾辈虽年轻，也当承担责任。
examples.pinyin: Wú bèi suī nián qīng, yě dāng chéng dān zé rèn.
examples.english: Though we are young, we should also shoulder responsibility.

examples.chinese: 工匠在弧形栏杆上刻出镂空花纹。

examples.pinyin: zhè fù bì gōu yòng pí gé zhì chéng.
examples.english: This armguard is made of leather.

examples.chinese: 他抬脚一蹽，很快就跑远了。
examples.pinyin: tā tái jiǎo yī liāo, hěn kuài jiù pǎo yuǎn le.
examples.english: He set off at a run and soon disappeared into the distance.

examples.chinese: 他一蹽就跑出了院子。
examples.pinyin: tā yì liāo jiù pǎo chū le yuàn zi.
examples.english: He dashed straight out of the courtyard.
